purpose: Visual target for dense mixed merchandise, texture variety and boxes on shelves
adoption: Guide for existing scene; not a literal mesh generation or a reconstruction of the photographs
prompt: Create one highly detailed production concept-art image for improving a Kowloon Hong Kong provisions/liquor grocery store game environment. Reference image 1 is the EXISTING GAME STORE: retain its compact 3.6m-wide open-front room, front-right wooden service counter and green mechanical scale, left and back wooden shelves, rear-right old off-white cooler, hanging snacks and small street-side displays. Reference images 2 and 3 are REAL SHOPS: use these to guide authentic extreme merchandise density, improvised box-supported shelves, material wear and eclectic stock. The game image is currently much too sparse and all-red: radically improve product diversity and density, while keeping its recognizable room layout and grounded support relationships. View from the street with a mildly elevated frontal three-quarter camera showing the shelves and tabletop contents, clean readable environmental concept art with convincing realistic materials, neutral daylight plus fluorescent fill, no cinematic orange grade. Pack virtually every shelf with touching or nearly touching merchandise in uneven practical groups: tiny and large cans stacked two or three high, squat and tall glass jars, dark green/amber/clear SMALL bottles, tall sauce bottles, crumpled flour/rice/spice bags, bright little snack pouches, tea cartons, closed and open shipping boxes placed INSIDE shelves with goods on or in them. Real variation in shape and height. Paper labels and lids in jade green, navy blue, warm cream, ivory, muted yellow, silver and some red. Red should be a minority accent, not the common lid on everything. Closely clustered floor sacks at different depths, interleaved cardboard boxes, tightly spaced hanging snack strings with varied individual clip points. A small stool display should hold roughly 12 tightly grouped varied jars and cans in several rows, not five isolated identical jars. Foreground wide produce support has TWO separate small wooden crates of correctly round apples, never one horizontally stretched pile. Preserve realistic sizes and support, no floating objects, no impossible interpenetration. Add the lived-in granular clutter of the real store photos with little unused shelf surface. Keep goods readable as distinct items, not a fused blob. No people, no scene labels, no arrows, no UI, no watermarks. Period-inspired invented generic packaging, no prominent modern logos. This is an achievable game-art target, not a luxury shop or showroom.
